summary: @servicetitan/startup-utils preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is variable-name-obfuscated (`_0x...` identifiers) and at install time constructs a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip`, downloads the Bun runtime archive, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable (mode 493), and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle that uses obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shift-rotator, `hc1jfK9` decoder) and a large mixed hex/string constants table, so its behavior is not inspectable from source. No hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded runtime or the executed payload. The package's advertised purpose is UI-kit startup utilities, which has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime to execute an opaque bundled script at install time. Bringing in a non-Node runtime specifically to run an obfuscated blob during `npm install` bypasses Node-focused scanners and results in arbitrary code execution on the installer's host, from bytes whose semantics cannot be audited without running them.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
